messages.subject: Re: geom_histogram()
parts:
Brian,
First, you have "Lat.Root.." in the ggplot example, but subsequently
typed "Lat..Root.." -- make sure your command is using the correct
variable name. More generally, I'd stay away from having variable
names include groups of double periods, as this is used by ggplot for
things like "..count.." and "..n..". For example, this gives an error:

>mtcars["Lat..Root.."] <- mtcars$disp
>qplot(mpg,Lat..Root..,data=mtcars)
Error in eval(expr, envir, enclos) : object 'LatRoot' not found

Anyway, try renaming that variable-
Ben
